title: Hecke algebra representations from the Katz-Long-Moody construction
summary: We study the Katz-Long-Moody (KLM) construction and classify exactly when the resulting braid group representations factor through Hecke algebras, for scalar braid part and semisimple free-group part, over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and at every convolution parameter lambda different from 1. We show that, except for one exceptional two-strand family, this property then depends only on the eigenvalues of the free-group part and is independent of lambda.
